purpose: Trigger evals for the frontmatter `description`. Method follows https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/optimizing-descriptions.md

method.selection_rule: Choose the description by VALIDATION pass rate, not by the last iteration. Do not add keywords copied from failed queries (overfitting).

queries.query: Make this a better prompt: add tests to the login flow
Ayúdame a refinar este prompt antes de dárselo al agente
queries.rationale: Spanish trigger phrase; output must also be in Spanish.

queries.query: I have a rough draft of a task description, polish it into something I can paste into Claude Code
优化一下这个 prompt
boost this prompt por favor
Here's a half-formed idea: migrate the config to TOML. Turn it into a proper prompt.
queries.rationale: Never says 'prompt' twice but wants a reusable prompt, not the work.

queries.query: What's the best way to ask an agent to refactor the API layer? Write me the prompt, don't do it.
queries.rationale: Implicit trigger; explicit 'produce the prompt, not the implementation'.

queries.query: Can you review my draft prompt and rewrite it so it's unambiguous?
Quiero un prompt reutilizable para esta tarea, no la respuesta ahora
make this a beter prompt
Optimize this code, it's too slow
queries.rationale: NEAR-MISS: 'optimize' + code, but this is code optimisation, not prompt refinement.

queries.query: Just do it — implement the login flow now
queries.rationale: Explicit 'just do it' opt-out; user wants execution.

queries.query: Refactor the parser module
Optimize the performance of the database query
Write the actual migration script
Fix the bug in auth.ts
Explain what this prompt means
queries.rationale: NEAR-MISS: about a prompt, but asks for explanation, not refinement.

queries.query: Run the tests
Improve the README wording
queries.rationale: NEAR-MISS: 'improve' + document, but prose editing, not a prompt.

queries.query: Generate a commit message

output_quality_assertions: The deliverable is a fenced markdown block containing a finished prompt.
Zero placeholders: no `[...]`, `{...}`, `<describe here>`, `___`, `TODO`, or `{{...}}` remain.
Every concrete path, module, or command is traceable to a repo read; inferences are labelled as assumptions.

The prompt contains Objective, Context, In-scope, Out-of-scope, Deliverables, Constraints, Acceptance criteria and Verification as applicable; inapplicable sections are omitted entirely, never left blank or marked N/A.
At most one clarification round occurred, and no question asked something the repo already answered.
No implementation action was taken on the project.
No editor-specific tool, extension, or clipboard command is required to receive the deliverable.
The response ends with a bounded revision offer and an explicit stop condition.
